-- Calculate average time to conversion (in days) and average interactions for premium members
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(m.memb_days), 2) AS avg_time_to_conversion_days,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN i_count.interaction_count IS NOT NULL THEN i_count.interaction_count END), 2) AS avg_interactions_before_conversion
FROM membershipandspending m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT interact_fan_pivot, COUNT(*) as interaction_count
    FROM interactions
    GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
) i_count ON i_count.interact_fan_pivot = m.member_fan_pivot
WHERE m.memb_kind != 'Free';

-- Let's see the full picture - how many premium members, their avg days, and interaction stats
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_premium_members,
    MIN(m.memb_days) as min_days,
    MAX(m.memb_days) as max_days,
    ROUND(AVG(m.memb_days), 2) AS avg_time_to_conversion_days,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN i_count.interaction_count IS NOT NULL THEN i_count.interaction_count END), 2) AS avg_interactions_before_conversion,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i_count.interaction_count IS NOT NULL THEN i_count.interaction_count ELSE 0 END) AS total_interactions
FROM membershipandspending m
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT interact_fan_pivot, COUNT(*) as interaction_count
    FROM interactions
    GROUP BY interact_fan_pivot
) i_count ON i_count.interact_fan_pivot = m.member_fan_pivot
WHERE m.memb_kind != 'Free';
